verdict.rationale: Terraform's state maps real-world resources to configuration, and `terraform plan` previews the changes needed to reconcile them, with JSON output for automation. That implies config-vs-reality comparison, but no evidence explicitly documents drift detection. A community report notes that resources created outside Terraform are simply ignored, so out-of-band resources go undetected. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of drift detection (e.g., refresh-only or scheduled drift checks), detection of unmanaged resources created outside Terraform, independent hands-on corroboration of drift workflows.
